commitResults.messageTitle: Harden undo history and customer deletion
commitResults.messageBody:
Undo stores the snapshot and the command text in separate fields, and
delete customer accepts numeric forms that are not plain IDs.

A missing half of a history pair, or an ID such as +21, can pass a
check that should reject it.

Let's keep each history snapshot with its command text, reject
non-digit customer IDs, and check nulls and duplicates on the customer
paths.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add initial dog command model support
Add dog creation and ID persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Dog records need a command flow, stable identity, and storage support for the daycare feature. Without persistent IDs, deleted dog IDs could be reused after restarting the application.

Add dog parsing and execution, assign IDs through AddressBook, serialize dogs and the next unused ID, and validate duplicate persisted IDs. Add parser and model tests for dog creation and ID behavior.

Keep dog IDs separate from names so multiple dogs may share a name while retaining distinct identities. Verify the changes with the full Gradle test suite.

Dog-related files contain formatting and documentation violations that fail the repository Checkstyle task.

Correct import ordering and spacing, add parser utility Javadocs, and reorder dog test imports so the dog changes satisfy Checkstyle without modifying customer code.

Dog records need collection-level identity checks so loading and future dog commands can reject duplicate persistent IDs.

Add UniqueDogList and DuplicateDogException, route AddressBook dog storage through the unique collection, and test duplicate IDs and unassigned dogs.

Keep ID generation in AddressBook while letting the collection enforce uniqueness.

Dog records need ID-based editing so users can update details without relying on list positions.

Add edit-dog parsing and execution, preserve persistent IDs during replacement, enforce duplicate checks in other list positions, and add command and parser tests.

Use exact ID lookup because deleted IDs are not reused and may leave gaps in the dog collection.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for dog command coverage
commitResults.messageBody: Add coverage for dog JSON conversion, add-dog and edit-dog commands, edit-dog parsing, and unique dog list behavior. Update existing dog ID expectations to use IDs starting at 1.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add activity enrolment and completion commands
commitResults.messageBody: Add enrolment and unenrolment commands with persistent enrolment records. Add mark and unmark commands with persisted activity completion state. Include parsers, model APIs, storage adapters, validation, and tests.

The Developer Guide does not show how the dog and activity features are designed and executed across application layers. This makes the persistent identity and enrolment decisions harder for future developers to understand.

Add implementation explanations and PlantUML diagrams for adding and editing dogs, enrolling and unenrolling dogs, and marking and unmarking activities. Integrate the diagrams beside the relevant explanations and document the rationale for persistent IDs, separate enrolment records, and immutable activity updates.

The UI displays customers and dogs in one combined list and does not expose activities through the Logic API. This makes each record type harder to view independently and prevents the activity list panel from being shown.

Add separate customer, dog and activity list panels, expose activities through Logic, and arrange the panels in three columns. Use observable lists so future filtering commands can update each column without changing the panel structure.

Activity command coverage does not exercise successful mark and unmark parsing, oversized enrolment IDs, or persisted completion states. These paths are reported as uncovered by JaCoCo and can reduce Codecov coverage for the activity pull request.

Add focused parser and storage tests for these cases so the activity command implementation is covered across normal and boundary inputs.

The activity model validation paths for duplicate, missing, and invalid enrolments are not all exercised by the existing tests. This leaves branches in AddressBook uncovered and can reduce Codecov patch coverage.

Add focused AddressBook tests for successful enrolment and unenrolment, invalid IDs, missing activities and dogs, duplicate enrolments, and removal of existing enrolments.

The new customer, dog and activity panels are not sufficiently exercised by the existing UI tests, which lowers Codecov coverage for the three-column layout.

Add JavaFX tests for card rendering, panel updates, empty panels, ownership display, and activity-column integration in the main window.
Add Activity Enrolment and Completion Commands
